messages:
Jordan S.: Quick update — closed Marlowe Health (Midmarket). 12‑month contract signed today: Dedicated capacity + Private eval (VPC, SSO). Expect initial ingest ~40M tokens/month for first 3 months. Renewal review in 9 months. Kickoff scheduled Thu 10am PST. Primary customer contacts: Emily (CTO) emily@marlowe.co, Ben (Platform) ben@marlowe.co. Sales notes + SOW: https://redwoodcorp.notreal/sales/marlowe

Priya K.: Thanks — I’ll own CS lead. I'll run the kickoff and own the onboarding roadmap. Need: 1) infra drop-in (network + firewall IPs) 2) SSO IdP metadata 3) eng SLA for private deploy timeline. Can someone confirm who'll own deploy?

Jordan S.: Assigning Marco for deploy + Lina for support triage. Quick SOW snippet:
```
Private deployment: 3-week pilot -> staging (1 GPU pool) -> production (2 reserved nodes)
Deliverables: VPC peering, IdP SAML, initial prompt set + eval, runbook
```
Customer asked for audit logging and KMS integration.

onboarding-bot: New onboarding created: MARLOWE-1234 — kickoff scheduled. Added to onboarding tracker.

Marco T.: I can handle the private deploy. Need: network CIDRs, who will provision peering? Also need model profile: they want small LLM for routing + 13B for main. Any preference on quantization? I'll open ENG-4789 for the work and link to the tracker.

Lena R.: Support here. I'll prepare a customer-specific playbook and SSO setup doc. Please share billing contact (for billing notifications) and whether they want a dedicated Slack channel/workspace for CS <> customer comms.

Tom (Support): I’ll create the support onboarding ticket and pre-populate runbook templates. Will also invite the account team to the support channel once we get the customer Slack request.

Priya K.: Action items —
- Priya: run kickoff Thu 10am PST (calendar invite sent) — owner: Priya — due: Thu
- Marco: open ENG-4789 + timeline for private deploy (PE to staging in 3w) — owner: Marco — due: next Tue
- Lena: draft support playbook + SSO guide — owner: Lena — due: next Wed
- Tom: create support ticket + invite process — owner: Tom — due: next Wed
- Jordan: share final SOW and 2FA/KMS requirements — owner: Jordan — due: EOD today

Risks/notes: Customer budget approved but exec sponsorship low; adoption metric we need to track: monthly active users and API throughput. Recommend a QBR at month 2 to boost adoption; mark renewal risk moderate if adoption lagging. Capture customer feedback about embeddings size — Emily asked about 1536 vs 3072 dims.

Jordan S.: Thanks team. Please flag blockers early. I'll be on the kickoff but handing ops to Priya. @Priya K. ping me if we need legal/contract followup.

Priya K.: Got it — will post the kickoff notes and owner tracker after the call. Planning an enablement session for Ben's infra team next week.

Marco T.: Noted. I'll include model quantization options in ENG-4789 and pre-run a perf estimate.

Lena R.: Will ask customer if they want a dedicated workspace; if yes, please provide list of internal attendees to invite.

Tom (Support): Copy. I'll add playbook links to the onboarding tracker.
